facts.fact: Xalam Analytics says the Projet de Couverture Nationale fibre project is underway, about 3,000 km of terrestrial fibre connecting key towns; document gives no event date, so its published date (January 2026) is used.

Xalam Analytics describes the Central African Backbone (CAB) project as ongoing, expanding Congo's fibre backbone reach to secondary towns and neighbouring countries; no event date given, so the published date (January 2026) is used.
